text:
Andrew K: quick sync — proposing a small API surface we call "tiered coalesce" so callers can express locality preference + deadline hints.
Maya S: short explainer? want to make sure this doesn't leak scheduler internals into the app layer.
Andrew K: idea is minimal: two knobs on request metadata: `locality_hint` (local, any, prefer-local) and `deadline_hint_ms`. scheduler uses that to pick coalesce bucket and admission path.
Jin Park: oh nice. so `local` would prefer same-gpu KV cache warm prefixes, reduce fetches. `deadline_hint_ms` used as packing deadline? any default?
Andrew K: default is 50ms for interactive, 200ms for batch. The scheduler still enforces global SLOs and headroom; these are hints not hard constraints.
Sara V: how do we avoid priority inversion? if many requests set `locality_hint=local`, could starvation happen for non-local ones.
Andrew K: good point — plan is admission tiering with proportional headroom per locality class + a soft-penalty for requests that repeatedly miss deadlines (demote after N misses).
Maya S: demotion + telemetry sounds fine. need a fallback path: when local capacity is full, should we immediately route to `any` path or queue longer for local slot?
Jin Park: prefer immediate fallback to `any` with a short grace queue (<= 10ms). Otherwise tail latencies explode under load.
Sara V: telemetry needed: per-request path tag (local_hit, local_fallback, remote). Also histograms of wait time and kvcache_miss_rate correlated with locality_hint.
queuebot: env=prod: new metric group `coalesce.surface.path_count` created (counter).
Maya S: API proposal example (proto-ish):

```proto
message CoalesceHint {
  enum Locality { LOCAL = 0; PREFER_LOCAL = 1; ANY = 2; }
  Locality locality_hint = 1;
  int32 deadline_hint_ms = 2; // advisory
}
```

Request metadata attaches `CoalesceHint`.
Jin Park: runtime internals: scheduler will maintain three active queues per lane (local/prefer/any) and a compacting worker that tries to pack prefer_local into local when headroom shows.
Andrew K: compaction logic: periodically (every 5ms) attempt to merge microbatches with matching kv prefixes. but compaction must be idempotent and cheap.
Sara V: merging microbatches risks increased memory spike and KV cache churn. need circuit breaker on compaction size and per-GPU mem tracking.
Maya S: agree. Also add a probe path that samples whisper requests to measure whether `prefer_local` actually reduces token cost for a workload.
Jin Park: for telemetry wire up labels: `coalesce.path`, `coalesce.compaction_size`, `coalesce.kv_cache_delta`.
Andrew K: rollout plan: start behind feature-flag on a single pool, sample 1%, validate tail p99 latency and token cost do not regress; then increase.
Sara V: can we implement policy in two stages? 1) surface-only (emit hint to telemetry, scheduler ignores) 2) actual enforcement. reduces blast radius.
Maya S: +1. surface-only for 2 weeks should give data to tune defaults.
Andrew K: implementation notes: avoid adding a 4th queue state. reuse lane concepts and attach tag metadata. admission controller uses token budget accounting.
Jin Park: question on fairness: when `prefer_local` users get consistent benefit, we might need tenant-level quotas to avoid noisy neighbor wins.
Sara V: yes, tie to tenant budget and per-tenant `preferred_local` budget; once budget exhausted, treat as `any`.
Maya S: minor: make sure SDKs have a simple boolean shorthand `prefer_local: true` and server maps to proto.
queuebot: infra note: canary deploy scheduled for 03/29 02:00 UTC for pool:inference-g4dn. Estimated window 20m.
Andrew K: ok next actions:
- Maya: draft proto + SDK shorthand (this week)
- Jin: prototype admission changes and compactor simulation (bench harness)
- Sara: define telemetry tables and alert thresholds (p99 tail > baseline+10% or token_cost increase >5%)
- Andrew: create feature-flag + rollout playbook

Maya S: I'll spin up the proto PR and include sample telemetry dashboards.
Jin Park: I'll run sim with heavy skew (90/10 tenant split) and report compaction memory delta.
Sara V: I'll propose alert queries and a dashboard wireframe.
Andrew K: thanks everyone. surface-only stage then re-eval after 2 weeks. :thumbsup:
Maya S: sounds good. I'll tag infra folks once PR is ready.
queuebot: reminder: please add COGS label to PRs touching admission logic.
Sara V: one last thought — we should document expected semantics in the API docs: clearly say these are hints, not guarantees, and describe demotion rules.
Andrew K: agreed. will add to docs PR.
Maya S: thanks all.
